budget.dollars: 2026 US dollars, planning-level (Class 5) estimate; not a quote
adders: 10% of construction (Concord estimate used 10% design escalation)
not included - add ~5%/yr to the mid-point of construction (Needham assumption)
excluded: Buying the Raynham Corp hill and any ring-road right-of-way (needs appraisal)
Tunnels between the compound and the pond (needs geotechnical study)
Hill regrading / bulk earthwork, utilities extensions, operations and maintenance
Contaminated-sediment handling if testing finds it
funding: Lighthouse and visitor features; naming rights
Two-town agreement (MGL c.40 s.4A intermunicipal agreement)
Shares costs and upkeep between Taunton and Raynham
MA Division of Ecological Restoration (DER) priority project + grants
Wetland / pond restoration design and construction
SNEP Watershed Implementation Grants (EPA Southeast New England Program)
Restoration in the Taunton River watershed
Community Preservation Act funds (where each town has adopted CPA)
Bank compound (commercial building - separate from public grants)

dredge_ma: Attleboro reservoir dredging plan (DredgeWire, Dec 2024): MA mechanical $50-75/CY; hydraulic ~$70/CY small, ~$50/CY large
dredge_hat: Day Pond Restoration bids, Hatfield MA (Nov 2025): dredging + dewatering + disposal $40-$240/CY
concord: Warner's Pond dredging estimate, Concord MA (SumCo, Dec 2024): $50/CY dredging; 10% preliminary design escalation
bog: Windswept Bog restoration (SNEP, 2024): $821,535 for 14 ac; $2.9M projected for 40 ac
eel: Eel River Headwaters, Plymouth (Mass. DER): ~60 ac former bog restored for ~$2M
harwich: Cold Brook, Harwich (SNEP case study): 66 ac, $1.25-1.5M
modot: MoDOT Cost Estimate Guide (updated Jan 2026): new 2-lane minor $1.575M + $1.225M/mi; major $2.15M + $1.675M/mi; +20% misc/utilities
compass: Compass International (2018): major 2-lane road, NE USA, ~$5.34M/mi
needham: Needham DPW planning-level estimate (Nov 2025): 20% contingency, 5%/yr inflation
rlb: RLB Quarterly Construction Cost Report Q4 2025, Boston: office prime $455-705/sf, secondary $270-405/sf; basement parking $140-190/sf (hard cost)
rlb26: RLB Q3 2026 via Bidmere (Nov 2026): Boston office prime $470-745/sf, secondary $290-435/sf
sand: Sandwich MA beach project grant application: $20/CY hopper-dredged, $35/CY trucked sand
sand2: Edgartown South Beach (DredgeWire): $21/CY local dredged sand vs at least $72/CY imported
gp: Great Point Lighthouse replica, Nantucket (1986): slightly over $1 million (Lighthouse Digest)
henlopen: Cape Henlopen Lighthouse replica proposal incl. keeper's house: close to $11 million (Lighthouse Digest)
assessor: Town of Raynham assessor record, parcel 10A-16-0 (0 E Britannia St): $303,900, exempt

phases: Concept, VR model and public plan
Two-town agreement + baseline studies (survey, sediment, wetland lines, NHESP)
Lake permitting: MEPA, both ConComs, 401, Corps 404, Ch.91
permits: MA Wetlands Protection Act (MGL c.131 s.40; 310 CMR 10.00)
Notice of Intent to BOTH the Taunton and Raynham Conservation Commissions -> Orders of Conditions; an Ecological Restoration Limited Project path (310 CMR 10.24(8)) may fit
Environmental Notification Form; large wetland alteration triggers a likely mandatory Environmental Impact Report
Clean Water Act s.401 Water Quality Certification (MassDEP, 314 CMR 9.00)
Needed for dredging / fill in waters and wetlands
U.S. Army Corps of Engineers - Clean Water Act s.404
Individual Permit likely at this scale (New England District)
Waterways licence if Fowling Pond is a great pond (natural pond over 10 acres) - MassDEP determination needed
NHESP / MA Endangered Species Act (321 CMR 10.00)
Check Priority Habitat maps; MESA review if mapped
Lighthouse height / use; compound site plan review
